caption: The drawing features a repeating pattern over a beige background, composed of diagonal lines that form diamond shapes across the composition. The lines are white with black accents and are adorned at the intersections by flower-like shapes. Inside each diamond, there are stylized floral elements including flowers, leaves, and stems, predominantly rendered in black and white with some gray shading. The topmost row of the pattern also incorporates bow shapes. Scattered throughout, small leaf clusters and rosebud-like forms are present inside and along the borders of the diamond shapes. A white rectangular label near the bottom center contains text in black, reading "FREEHAND WALL DECORATION WINDSOR, CONN. 1784-1800 PLATE 4," and there are handwritten notes in pencil below the printed label.
title: Free Hand Decoration
